fields.title: Column name
fields.description: Column containing the paths to the files/folders whose meta information must be extracted.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Fail if file/folder does not exist
fields.description: If checked, the node fails if any of the referenced files or folders does not exist.

fields.title: Calculate overall folder size
fields.description: If checked, the size of the folder itself plus everything located within this folder is being calculated, otherwise solely the folder's size is being calculated.

fields.title: Append permissions
fields.description: If checked, the file/folder permissions, i.e., readable, writable, and executable flags will be appended to the output. In case the file system does not provide access to these attributes missing values are written to the output. Note: The meaning of the executable flag with respect to folders is file system dependent, e.g., on UNIX systems this flag is true if the JVM has permissions to search the directory.

fields.title: Append POSIX attributes
fields.description: If checked, a set of columns that capture POSIX attributes (owner, group and permission bits) will be appended to the output. In case the file system does not provide access to these attributes missing values are written to the output. Note: The meaning of the permission bits depend on the actual file system.
